ev.q: The primary outcome occurred among 25 (4.4%) of 568 recipients of hepatitis A vaccine and 17 (3.3%) of 522 IG recipients
Assuming IG is 90% efficacious, the point estimate for hepatitis A vaccine efficacy relative to IG in preventing clinical hepatitis A was 86%
This report details updated recommendations, made by ACIP in June 2007
On the basis of this evidence and the expert opinions of workgroup members
